notes.title: Pet for one penny when you buy Start Running
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389106/ec58821a5a2cc133e4716bad12cc0f32adfe15ea.png[/img]

With the release of Start Running, my second game on Steam, I've made a bundle that combines both Pet and Start Running into a "buy one get the other for a penny" deal.

Start Running is a much longer adventure that combines point and click, escape room, visual novel, and horror game. It's still in Ren'Py, but it pushes the engine a lot further than Pet did, since I gained so many more skills in the last year.

After doing game development for the last 18 months, I'm super proud of both of these games, and am on to my next project.

[u][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43201/Curious_Gods/]Check out the bundle if you want to grab both games.[/url][/b][/u]

Thanks, as always, for your support!

notes.title: Pet price drop (forever!)
notes.notes: In anticipation of my next game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2544330/Start_Running/]Start Running[/url], releasing in the next month or two, I'm lowering the price of Pet to $1.99 from now on. I appreciate everyone who has been able to buy the game, and if you haven't had a chance to check it out, I hope you can now. Thank you again for playing it!

notes.title: Pet releasing on Steam August 2nd!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

Pet is going to be released on Steam on August 2nd, 2023.

I first released Pet in March 2023. 

The process to get on Steam took me a few months. Some of it was having to get over the hurdle of the fear of the process. It's a lot more complicated than other platforms might be, and I also had to add things like achievements and make a bunch of additional content for promotion. 

Adding achievements was easier than I thought it would be, and I think the ones I've added will reward exploration and also finding all endings.

My biggest fear in releasing Pet is regarding the length of the game: exploring all of Pet and getting all endings should take around an hour if you go through and read all the text, and that's shorter than the refund amount for a game. 

In the process of development, I waffled between trying to figure out how to make the game "longer" and how to make the game good. There's a lot of FMV games where moving between places takes a while as the world turns and the player sits patiently, but I don't think that's helpful for this game. I chose instead to just let the game transition quickly. 

Over all, I'm still very happy with the choices I made with Pet, the small updates I made to launch on Steam, and I'm excited to see what other people think. 

Pet is eventually going to be the first entry in a trilogy. My husband and I have been working on the second game in the series, Start Running, which is about 50% done. 

Thank you so much for checking this out, and I am excited for people to get to play it on Steam on August 2nd.
